summary: Sh. Ali Mashhour continues teaching from a fiqh book focused on Salah (prayer), explaining why the author takes a detour to discuss the importance of Salah in Islam before covering rulings. Sh. Ali Mashhour discusses the five pillars of Islam as defined by the Prophet Muhammad, using an analogy to explain how Islam is defined by its most prominent external features and individual obligations. He emphasizes that Salah is arguably the most critical pillar of Islam after the Shahada, as it is the only act of worship where scholars differ on whether someone who completely abandons it can still be considered Muslim.
